The '''2018 LPL Summer''' split was the second split of the year in China’s franchised '''LoL Pro League''' (''LPL''), organized by Tencent Games. Fourteen teams competed from 11 June to 14 September across venues in Shanghai, Hangzhou, Chengdu, Chongqing, Xi’an, Nanjing, and Beijing. The league featured a two-group Regular Season followed by a Single Elimination Playoffs bracket, with the champion qualifying for the [[World Championship/2018|Worlds 2018]]. Matches were played offline on patches ranging from 8.11 to 8.16, with {{ChampionIcon|Ornn}} briefly disabled and {{ChampionIcon|Taliyah}} and {{ChampionIcon|Karthus}} restricted from taking Smite during the first three days.

Multiple teams hosted matches at homegrounds: [[LGD Gaming]] at the LGD Gaming C & E Center in Hangzhou, [[Snake Esports]] at the Chongqing Expo in Chongqing, [[Oh My God]] at the Eastern Suburb Memory in Chengdu, [[Team WE]] at Guangdian Grand Theatre in Xi’an, [[Royal Never Give Up]] at RNG eSport Center and Wukesong Arena in Beijing, with the Finals held at Nanjing YOG Sport Park Gymnasium.

{{ShowBracket|id=G8XDBUEPQK}}

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
** 2 groups of 6 teams each.
** Each team plays 16 matches.
*** Double Round Robin within own group
*** Single Round Robin against other group
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st place of each group''}} advance to the Semfinals of the Playoffs.
** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''2nd place of each group''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd place of each group''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs, and will start the series with a 1-game advantage.
** {{bgcolortext|stayup|''4th place of each group''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs.
** {{bgcolortext|stay|''5th till 7th place of each group''}} qualify for [[LPL/2019/Spring|Spring split]]
* '''Playoffs'''
** Single elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
** Winner qualifies for [[World Championship/2018|Worlds 2018]]
